Consult request from the facility's licensed wildlife rehabilitator.

Eastern box turtle, adult, brought in lethargic and minimally responsive with sunken eyes. This is consistent with simple dehydration, which responds well to fluid therapy, and also with septicemia, which requires immediate systemic treatment and carries a much poorer prognosis. Bloodwork can be run today. Reptile presentations are notoriously nonspecific without diagnostics.
